content.summary: The fresh manuscript frames a completed support reduction accurately while preserving the separate exclusion obligation. Both manuscript and canonical snapshot hashes match. Scoped source inspection supports the distinction between a universal family theorem and its numerical leaf; retained dependency-object trust remains explicit.

checks.method: Inspected SupportFinish53's signature and assembly, comparing its named root with F11 and F24.
checks.observation: The root assumes exactly 28 distinct rank-four members, sunflower-freeness, and reflexive intersection over Type u. Its proof explicitly obtains four highest-degree points, derives codegree and degree-sum bounds, invokes the natural grid wrapper, and concludes by arithmetic contradiction. I(27) is absent from the signature. Receipts report the root with only the three allowed axioms; this review did not rebuild dependencies.

checks.method: Read both directions of the Fin-53 equivalence and its counterexample reduction in SupportReduction.
checks.observation: The source selects a 28-member subfamily, inherits the hypotheses, applies support 53, and invokes injective relabeling. The reverse implication assumes obstruction nonexistence; no exclusion is supplied. This matches the manuscript's remaining encoding, coverage, symmetry, and certificate obligations.
